title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 + Studio for sale at Lake Dry!
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 + Studio for sale at Lake Dry! The apartment is located in the "Bora" Residential Complex, organized with 3 buildings, built in recent years according to the highest construction standards, under a very good administration and management. Information about the Apartment: - New Building - Floor 1 Residential (3rd from the entrance quota) - There are only 2 apartments on the Floor - Total Area: 102 Apt + 26 Veranda that has a closed part - Orientation: South-East - Perimeter balcony with a relaxing view of the Hill - Veranda - Small storage room - Post Parking with extra price - Accessible by elevator from the parking lot and from the main entrance for pedestrians of the building Organization: - Distribution Corridor - Living Room - Kitchen Area - Matrimonial Bedroom with Toilet - Children's Bedroom - Studio with Fantastic View + Laundry and Wardrobe - Toilet - Price 255,000 euros
